drills.title: Fix the SmPC
drills.about: Clear every QRD, black triangle, 4.8, excipient, strength and promotional finding in the Ostrevia SmPC.

drills.title: Repair the package leaflet
drills.about: Restore the standard statements, headings, excipient statement and consistency with the SmPC.

drills.title: Fix the outer carton
drills.about: Children warning, Braille, the safety features and the authorisation number.

drills.title: Fix Annex II and a small vial label
drills.about: The 5 mL vial carries only the minimum particulars of Annex IIIA: name with the route, method, EXP, Lot and contents. Two are missing or wrongly marked.

drills.title: Generic SmPC against the reference
drills.about: Remove the last mention of the patent-protected indication and restore the warning that must match the reference SmPC.

drills.title: Declare a new excipient
drills.about: The 25 mg tablet now contains lactose. Add the statements to SmPC 4.4, the leaflet (section 2) and the carton (section 3).

drills.title: Pass the user test
drills.about: Run a round, rewrite the sections participants could not use, and pass two final rounds of 10 on the same text (16 of 20 on every question).

drills.title: Review the French leaflet
drills.about: Fix the dose, the missing period and the wrong term against the English and the term base, then answer the linguistic review comments.

drills.title: Capstone: implement a PRAC signal recommendation
drills.about: Add the PRAC wording on DRESS to SmPC 4.4 and 4.8 and leaflet sections 2 and 4, approve both, classify the variation and record the submission before the 60-day deadline.
